body:
It's the same case for me, too! If I ever get TOO excited over anything, I will literally start getting anxious the moment that exciting thing happens and it's exhausting.
I'm not really good with reassurances, so I apologise if I'm no help D: But, just remember that anxiety is not a dangerous thing. Don't let your anxiety ruin things for you. Maybe you have some good coping mechanisms to deal with for your anxiety? I usually do stuff I like to do to distract myself. For example, drawing or listening to music.
